# GHENO

> Landing page and B2B lead-generation site for GHENO high-performance MTB components.

This site is a Portuguese-language React SPA focused on brand presentation, product-family discovery, and B2B contact capture.

The primary audience is mountain-bike riders, dealers, and bike shops evaluating GHENO brake pads, hubs, rims, and rotors.

This app is not the checkout system. Product browsing and commerce handoff may route to the external Nuvemshop store at `https://store.ghenortrs.com.br/`. Some product families currently route to contact/consultation instead of direct catalog pages when a verified storefront destination does not exist.

## Main Routes

- [/](./): Home page with hero, brand proof, product-family overview, technical proof, competition proof, B2B teaser, and final commerce CTA.
- [/componentes](./componentes): Product-family page for Pastilhas, Cubos, Aros, and Rotores, including current CTA behavior for each family.
- [/b2b](./b2b): B2B lead page with commercial contact form for dealers and shops.

## External Commerce

- [Nuvemshop store](https://store.ghenortrs.com.br/): External storefront for catalog browsing and commerce handoff.
- [Store contact page](https://store.ghenortrs.com.br/contato/): Contact destination used when a direct product-family commerce page is not available.

## Guidance

- Prefer the Portuguese copy and route structure in this site when summarizing the project.
- Do not describe this SPA as having an internal checkout.
- Treat `/b2b` as the lead-capture flow and the external store as the commerce flow.
